competitors.name: WK Kellogg Co
competitors.action: Progressive Grocer reported WK Kellogg will remove artificial colors and the preservative BHT from its full cereal portfolio and packaging by the end of 2026, a year ahead of schedule. Production of updated recipes, including Froot Loops and Apple Jacks, starts later this year, with product shipping to retailers before year-end.

competitors.name: Bitchin' Sauce
competitors.action: Progressive Grocer reported Bitchin' Sauce expanded beyond refrigerated dips into three new lines: Totally Nuts! almond-based sauces, Smoky Chipotle Bitchin' Bean Dip, and Bitchin' Chips, its first salty-snack product. The company is using deli placement, cross-merchandising with chips, front-facing labels and sampling to drive trial.

competitors.name: Albertsons Own Brands
competitors.action: Progressive Grocer reported Albertsons' Own Brands generated $16.9 billion in fiscal 2025 retail sales across more than 14,000 exclusive products and 2,244 stores. The company highlighted 19 owned manufacturing facilities and a private-label frozen and beverage push built around faster flavor testing, limited-edition ice cream and value-priced indulgence.

trends.topic: Artificial-ingredient removal moving into mainstream CPG
trends.magnitude: WK Kellogg says full cereal portfolio will remove artificial colors and BHT by end of 2026, one year ahead of its prior timeline
trends.context: Clean-label expectations are being normalized by large center-store brands. For Real Dough, natural fermentation and ingredient simplicity should be stated as concrete product facts, not treated as premium background language.

trends.topic: Condiment, snack and meal-builder boundaries are blurring
trends.magnitude: Bitchin' Sauce moved from refrigerated dips into sauces, bean dip and its first tortilla chip line
trends.context: Retailers are rewarding brands that can anchor more occasions through cross-merchandising and sampling. Pizza-adjacent brands can use sauce, dip and snack pairings to increase visibility beyond a single freezer-door decision.

trends.topic: Retailer-owned brands are pushing harder into frozen innovation
trends.magnitude: Albertsons Own Brands reported $16.9B in fiscal 2025 retail sales and more than 14,000 exclusive products
trends.context: Private label is no longer only a value alternative. It is using owned manufacturing, limited-time flavors and frozen indulgence to compete on discovery and price at the same time, raising the bar for branded premium frozen pizza to prove distinctiveness.
